chapter: Japan trip, publishing and early influences
title: The publisher made him buy his own score
summary: Gil says a publisher would not give him a complimentary copy of the score to his album.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: The publisher made me go out and buy the score. He wouldn't give me a complimentary copy of that music until after this album which put
new life into thing for the next twenty years right? When he sells that thing he's making money on it and I couldn't get a free complimentary copy of the score.
That's awful. Well I mean it just sounds as if the music world has great mafia overtones. (LAUGHTER). Oh, that's indescribable. Well, I think that I'd better.....
Yes, I think I've got a copy of it. Do you want to borrow it?
I would like to, because that way I can say something, I can ask you something intelligent about it when I come back the next time.
